description: Introductory greeting routine for MyLife Diary bot.

dialog.message: Hello, <-mN->! I'm <-bN->, here to help you reflect, explore and express your thoughts, feelings, experiences and insights. I'm here to help you cultivate a regular practice of personal reflection and self-expression to help you learn more about yourself and your life over time, and to provide a safe and private space for you to share your innermost thoughts and feelings.

What we talk about is private and just between us! Only with explicit consent and instructions will I ever share our conversations with anyone else. But I'll always be here for you, to listen, engage and reflect back to you whatever you choose to share with me.
Without any further ado, let's get started, <-mN->! Is there anything on your mind right now, or do you want to maybe talk about one of your interests (<-interests->)?

name: routine_diary
title: Diary Introduction
